title: Write 9 · 欢 吃 谁 新 打 快 比 话 月 车 开 方 电 路 早
focus: 欢 吃 谁 新 打 快 比 话 月 车 开 方 电 路 早
body:
Repeating parts: 讠 speech (谁, 话), 扌 hand (打), 忄 heart (快), ⻊ foot (路), 日 (电, 早), 欠 (欢).

## Rules that matter here
- **Horizontal before vertical**: 车, 开, 早's 十 — the vertical comes at the end.
- **忄**: dot, dot, then the vertical.
- 电: the hooked tail through 日 is last.

cards.Notes: 又 hand (2) + 欠 yawn (4) = 6 strokes. Left before right. Lookalike: 次 (冫 + 欠).
口 mouth (3) + 乞 (3: ノ, 一, 乙, phonetic qǐ) = 6 strokes. Left before right.

cards.Prompt: 是＿？ · shì shéi · who is it?
cards.Notes: 讠 speech (2) + 隹 short-tailed bird (8, phonetic zhuī) = 10 strokes. Also read shuí. Lookalike: 难 (又 + 隹).
亲 (9: 立 + 木-like) + 斤 axe (4) = 13 strokes. Left before right. Lookalike: 亲 alone.

cards.Prompt: ＿电话 · dǎ diànhuà · to make a phone call
cards.Notes: 扌 hand (3) + 丁 (2, phonetic dīng) = 5 strokes. 扌: 一, vertical hook, rising stroke; then 丁.
忄 heart (3) + 夬 (4, phonetic guài) = 7 strokes. 忄: left dot, right dot, then the vertical. Lookalike: 块 (土).
Two 匕 side by side = 4 strokes: 一, 竖提 (left), then ノ, 竖弯钩 (right). Left before right.
讠 speech (2) + 舌 tongue (6) = 8 strokes. Left before right. Lookalike: 活 (氵 + 舌).
4 strokes: ノ, 横折钩, then two inner horizontals. Lookalikes: 用, 目.
4 strokes: 一, 𠃋 (撇折), 一, then the vertical LAST. A simplified cart seen from above.
4 strokes: 一, 一, ノ, then the vertical. Horizontal before vertical. Lookalike: 井 (two verticals cross both lines).
4 strokes: dot, 一, 横折钩, then ノ last. Lookalikes: 万 (no dot), 力.
日 (4) + a vertical with a hooked tail (乚) through it = 5 strokes. 日 first, the 竖弯钩 LAST.
⻊ foot (7) + 各 each (6, phonetic-ish) = 13 strokes. Left before right. Lookalike: 跟 (⻊ + 艮).
日 sun (4) + 十 (2) = 6 strokes. Top before bottom. Sun above the horizon line = early. Lookalike: 旱 (干).
